note: Prairie recreation-area campground on the west side of the Lake McGregor reservoir, just west of the Village of Milo: about 100 sites scattered along two lanes running 1 km down the shore, many with lake views. Sites 49, 92A and 93-95 just south of the day-use area sit on open ground 10-45 m from the water; most others are 60-100 m back behind grass, shrubs or a tree line. Boat launch and day-use area with a picnic shelter; no firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 9, 2026) and tear sheet: 100 unserviced first-come sites C$20, vault toilets, non-potable pump, playground, boat launch; season CHANGED 05-01 (derived, no close) -> May 8 - Oct 13. Lakefront kept only for a few named sites (49, 92A, 93-95) with a caveat in the note. Phone 403-394-0150 suggested; website -> camping page. Seniors line present.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - keep with a caveat naming sites, or lakeview): on the tear sheet the east lane south of the day-use area carries sites 92A, 49 and 93-99; on Esri imagery of 2024-07-20 the stretch right below the day-use tree line (where 92A, 49 and 93-95 plot) is open sand and grass all the way to the water, with camping units ~30-45 m and vehicles ~5-10 m from the edge. From about site 96 south, a shrub/tree belt stands between the pads and the shore. The long northern rows (sites 1-48, 50-91) sit 60-100 m from the water behind a grass/shrub meadow with a marshy fringe and a shoreline track; the north end is ~100 m back. The page says only 'many offer lake views'. Site numbers are placed from the tear-sheet map against imagery (the map is schematic). If the reviewer is not satisfied by map placement, recommend lakeview. The reservoir is drawn down in late season, which widens the gap.
